_about: Scheduled jobs Lorenzo turned off: he runs them by hand now (2026-09-22). Their code stays in git. They are not in services/reply_engine/modal_app.py SCHEDULES, not in changesets/schedules/schedules.json's schedule list and not in the staged laptop files; changesets/schedules/build_schedules.py --check refuses a name that is here AND scheduled. Readers (through shared/turned_off.py): jobs/retro_packet.py, jobs/pipeline_sweep.py, jobs/daily_metrics.py, changesets/deploy/watch_report.py and changesets/schedules/laptop_runner.py, which show these as 'turned off', never as missing or failed. To schedule one again: put it back in modal_app.SCHEDULES, delete it here, regenerate with build_schedules.py.
